name: agentpay-lookup-mcp-server
title: AgentPay Domain & Network Lookup
summary: DNS records, WHOIS/RDAP registration, IP ownership and one-call domain reports for AI agents. Listing tools is free; tool calls are paid per call.
description: AgentPay Domain & Network Lookup is a remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, stateless) with four tools: lookup_dns (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, CAA, PTR and SRV records, $0.005), lookup_whois (registrar, dates, status and nameservers via RDAP, $0.01), lookup_ip (network owner, range, country and reverse DNS, $0.01) and lookup_domain_report (registration, DNS, email provider, SPF/DMARC and hosting in one call, $0.02). Data comes from DNS over HTTPS, registry RDAP servers and the regional internet registries. Connecting, initialize and tools/list are free and need no account or API key. Tool calls are priced in USDC and paid either per call with x402 (USDC on Base, eip155:8453, or on Algorand) passed in the tool call's _meta field, or by sending an optional Authorization: Bearer header with a prepaid credits key bought at https://agentpay.agentpay-apis.workers.dev/credits/buy.
